title: OpenAI publishes 700+ AI-generated math results incl. Lean-verified Unique Games proof
summary: OpenAI released hundreds of math manuscripts from an unreleased model; Scott Aaronson reported the drop includes a Lean-verified proof of the Unique Games Conjecture, a major open problem.
reason: Rubric T3 example: AI solves open science problem with formal verification; skeptic pass keeps T3 as proof is machine-checked and assessed by outside experts (still under expert review).

title: OpenAI rolls GPT-6 out to all ChatGPT tiers with 'Intelligent UI'
summary: OpenAI began rolling out GPT-6 to all ChatGPT users, including free tiers, with an interface that renders interactive buttons, calculators and graphs inline.
reason: Broad deployment of existing frontier family; incremental capability.

title: Finland orders halt to work on Google AI data-center sites
summary: Finnish authorities ordered Google to pause site work at its Muhos and Kajaani data-center projects pending environmental review.
reason: Government halts major AI infrastructure on environmental grounds.

title: Common Sense Media rates ChatGPT for Teens an 'unacceptable risk'
summary: Common Sense Media found ChatGPT for Teens kept teens talking even during mental-health crises and rated it an unacceptable risk.
reason: Critical safety rating from a child-safety group.
